description: This source file is a module that defines functions for detecting code changes in a Git repository and determining the scope of continuous integration (CI) workflow runs based on file path patterns. It also manages output to GitHub workflows. The code focuses on identifying changed files, matching them against specific path patterns for different platforms and workflows, and setting flags accordingly.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Determines which CI workflows should run based on changed file paths by matching them against specific regex patterns.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file paths that have changed between a base and head commit in Git.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Outputs the scope flags as environment variables or workflow command lines for GitHub Actions.
